Part 2 · 2.1 Fill in the blanks (1/6) · Which word fits blank (1)?
📖 Passage (blanks 1–6)

Milling is cutting done by a milling machine, often using toothed cutting (1) ______ (wheels with teeth that have sharp edges). When a workpiece is milled, it is held in a (2) ______ position on the machine, and is shaped by cutting tools which rotate while being moved over the surface of the workpiece. Sawing is cutting using a (3) ______ (a thin, sharp piece of metal), which usually has teeth, to remove a thickness of material slightly wider than the blade. The gap left by the blade, along the line of the cut, is called a (4) ______. Machines that use toothed blades include circular saws, band saws, and power hacksaws. A hacksaw has a blade with very small (5) ______, for cutting metal. Saws may also use abrasive wheels – thin, circular cutting wheels with tough, hard surfaces – often made of industrial diamond. Grinding is removing material across a surface area, using (6) ______ wheels. The machines used to grind material are called grinders.

Part 2 · 2.2 Mark each statement True or False (1/2)
📖 Passage

Milling is cutting done by a milling machine, often using toothed cutting discs (wheels with teeth that have sharp edges). When a workpiece is milled, it is held in a fixed position on the machine, and is shaped by cutting tools which rotate while being moved over the surface of the workpiece. Sawing is cutting using a blade (a thin, sharp piece of metal), which usually has teeth, to remove a thickness of material slightly wider than the blade. The gap left by the blade, along the line of the cut, is called a kerf. Machines that use toothed blades include circular saws, band saws, and power hacksaws. A hacksaw has a blade with very small teeth, for cutting metal. Saws may also use abrasive wheels – thin, circular cutting wheels with tough, hard surfaces – often made of industrial diamond. Grinding is removing material across a surface area, using abrasive wheels. The machines used to grind material are called grinders.

statements.text: A milling machine holds the workpiece in a fixed position while the cutting tools rotate.
A kerf is the waste metal produced when a workpiece is cut.
Circular saws, band saws and power hacksaws all use toothed blades.
A hacksaw blade has very large teeth for cutting wood.

questions.explanation: Milling: máy giữ phôi cố định, dao quay. Kerf là khe cắt (waste = swarf). Hacksaw: very small teeth, for cutting metal.

questions.question:
Part 2 · 2.3 Choose the best answer (1/6) · What does milling use to cut the workpiece?
📖 Passage

Milling is cutting done by a milling machine, often using toothed cutting discs (wheels with teeth that have sharp edges). When a workpiece is milled, it is held in a fixed position on the machine, and is shaped by cutting tools which rotate while being moved over the surface of the workpiece. Sawing is cutting using a blade (a thin, sharp piece of metal), which usually has teeth, to remove a thickness of material slightly wider than the blade. The gap left by the blade, along the line of the cut, is called a kerf. Machines that use toothed blades include circular saws, band saws, and power hacksaws. A hacksaw has a blade with very small teeth, for cutting metal. Saws may also use abrasive wheels – thin, circular cutting wheels with tough, hard surfaces – often made of industrial diamond. Grinding is removing material across a surface area, using abrasive wheels. The machines used to grind material are called grinders.

Part 4 · Translate into Vietnamese (1/2).
Machining is the use of machines to cut pieces of material (called workpieces) and shape them into components.
answers: Gia công cắt gọt là việc sử dụng máy để cắt các mảnh vật liệu (gọi là phôi) và tạo hình chúng thành các chi tiết.
Gia công cắt gọt là dùng máy để cắt các mảnh vật liệu (gọi là phôi) và tạo hình chúng thành các chi tiết.
questions.explanation: workpieces = phôi; components = chi tiết; machines = máy.

questions.question:
Part 4 · Translate into Vietnamese (2/2).
During machining, a liquid called cutting fluid may be pumped onto the workpiece to act as a coolant, keeping the workpiece cool.
answers: Trong quá trình gia công, một chất lỏng gọi là dung dịch cắt gọt có thể được bơm lên phôi để đóng vai trò chất làm mát, giữ cho phôi nguội.
Trong khi gia công, một chất lỏng gọi là dung dịch cắt gọt có thể được bơm lên phôi để làm chất làm mát, giữ cho phôi nguội.
questions.explanation: cutting fluid = dung dịch cắt gọt; coolant = chất làm mát; pumped = được bơm.
